findings.title: L-BFGS-B ftol=1e-6 stops the solve and its in-loop restart short of their own fixed point
findings.claim: On two|dhw|summer_typical|winter_cold at 48 h, production's own L-BFGS-B restarted from the shipped plan at ftol=1e-12 lowers the recorded objective by 0.6507 % (55.3274 to 54.9674) at equal comfort.
findings.mechanism: Every main run stops on RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH after 8-36 iterations on 192 variables; _lbfgsb_restart then stops after 1 iteration on the same test, so the in-loop polish adopts nothing.

evidence.machine: box B2: 4-CPU Linux container, python3.14 venv, OpenBLAS pinned to 1 thread
evidence.contention_note: up to two other seats' finders running (load1 3-6); the value is an objective ratio and is contention-immune
evidence.tolerance: +-0.05 pp on this box; BLAS-dependent across boxes

perturbation.change: polish.py --perturb ftol_tight: production's ftol passed to _scoped_minimize rewritten from 1e-6 to 1e-12 in memory

findings.metric_definition: (f_prod - f_polish)/|f_prod| on the first seam call's recorded objective; f_polish is production's L-BFGS-B from the shipped x at ftol 1e-12, gtol 1e-10
findings.phenomenon_property: The shipped plan is a fixed point of production's own L-BFGS-B (same objective, bounds and jac) to within a relative 1e-4.

null_control.note: At flat prices the residue is at most 0.0231 % (48 h) and 0.0070 % (24 h, race.py).

findings.proposed_fix_scope: optimizer.py _multi_start_minimize / _lbfgsb_restart stop rule (ftol) or a gradient-norm-based stop; weigh against the recorded #1293 refusal (tests/optimality.py claim for one|shoulder|winter_cold).

findings.title: Multi-start seed set misses lower basins on shoulder prices, above the flat-price null
findings.claim: On the 24 h shoulder-price grid (16 cells, excluding summer_warm), the production seed set's plan is beaten by the recorded candidates plus an Emax-fraction bang-bang ladder by up to 1.2012 % (mean 0.3909 %, 8 of 16 cells over 0.1 %) at equal comfort, against a flat-price null of at most 0.3247 % (mean 0.0918 %).
findings.mechanism: The objective landscape is rugged: on one|nodhw|shoulder|shoulder, single seeds refine to between -3.5 % and +1.2 % of the shipped objective. Production's four or five energy-anchored starts all descend into a ~7.2 kWh basin, while an 8.5 kWh basin is reached only from seeds unrelated to the baseline energy (for example 0.8*Emax). The 1.25-2.0x baseline anchors do not reach it.

evidence.unit: % of shipped objective (max over shoulder cells)

null_control.note: A basin gap exists at flat prices too (comfort/terminal trade); the shoulder excess over the matched flat cell is the price-optimality part, up to 1.17 pp on one|dhw|shoulder|shoulder.

findings.proposed_fix_scope: optimizer.py seed construction in _optimize_space_only/_solve_space: more diverse structural starts, weighed against the #1294 cost refusal; the baseline-multiple anchors alone do not close it (anchor.py).
